name: Hearts of Zeal
summary: Master Apothecary Faranell needs Hearts of Zeal for a dangerous experiment. He asks you to gather them from Scarlet Crusade disciples at the Scarlet Monastery.

sections.title: Faranell's Experiment
sections.body: Faranell seeks a rare kind of guano for his experiment in the Undercity. He plans to combine opposing chemical substances with a toxic agent. At the Scarlet Monastery in northeastern Tirisfal Glades, you are to bring him the zealous hearts of the Scarlet Crusade's disciples.

faq.q: Who wants the Hearts of Zeal?
faq.answer: Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity wants the Hearts of Zeal for an experiment.

faq.q: Where are the Scarlet Crusade disciples?
faq.answer: The disciples gather at the Scarlet Monastery in the northeastern peaks of Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: What does Faranell plan to do with the hearts?
faq.answer: Faranell is conducting an experiment with opposing chemical substances and a toxic agent, and wants the zealous hearts.

faq.q: How many Hearts of Zeal does Faranell need?
faq.answer: Faranell asks for twenty Hearts of Zeal.
